WP4 · Work package

Dynamic-scenario stress testing

WP4 delivers a library of test scenarios in which rules change mid-flight (moving NFZ, time-window switch, corridor swap), and a harness that runs them and computes the KPIs. Under the grant, every KPI in the final report comes from this harness.

What the grant asks for

“every reported KPI in the final report comes from a Stress Testing run executed in the [hil] topology”Grant, Stress Testing page

Main files: guardrail/scenario_spec.py experiments/profiles/ guardrail/kpi.py tools/kpi_report.py guardrail/replay.py guardrail/manifest.py

Built

  • A scenario specification

    ScenarioSpec and ScenarioEvent follow the grant's Stress Testing page field for field, with expected-outcome and expected-fail-safe labels and seeds.

    guardrail/scenario_spec.py

  • Smoke and nightly profiles

    A smoke profile of 52 scenarios × 1 seed and a nightly profile of 211 × 3 seeds, with stressors for wind, gusts, start jitter and GPS dropout.

    experiments/profiles/

  • A manifest for every episode

    Each episode records the code revision, the weights hash, the policy hash, the seed, the simulation speed-up and the topology, so any number can be traced back to what produced it.

    guardrail/manifest.py

  • A KPI report with baselines

    The report computes the grant's KPIs per scenario family from the logs on disk, prints each score next to its null baseline, and marks a value that cannot be measured as such instead of printing a zero.

    tools/kpi_report.py guardrail/kpi.py

  • Replay bundles and a regression sweep

    Episodes are packed into replay bundles that re-derive their own KPIs, and a 13-scenario headless sweep guards the Shield against regressions.

    guardrail/replay.py experiments/sweep_scenarios.py

Shown

  • Profiles run end to end

    Smoke: 52 episodes in 15.9 s. Nightly: 633 episodes in 223 s. Both headless (no simulator).

  • A KPI report over the stored episodes

    The report has been run over 742 stored episodes: flights re-scored from their own logs, stress bundles and sweep scenarios, each group tabulated separately.

    Reproduce: python tools/kpi_report.py

Next for this work package

  • Next October 2026 Run the VLA and the Shield on the Jetson Orin, with the simulators on the desktop (the grant's hil topology), and time the Shield there at the load the grant states its budget for (50 rules, 50 future poses per tick) against the 5 ms query budget.
  • Next October – November 2026 Perception rail: Project AirSim simulates the drone and its camera while ArduPilot SITL flies it through Project AirSim's ArduPilot controller, with the Shield in front of MAVROS 2.
  • Next October – November 2026 A stress harness that starts ArduPilot SITL sessions, changes rules mid-flight and collects each episode as a bundle with rosbag2.
  • Next November 2026 KPI campaign: dynamic scenarios with at least 3 seeds each, on the hil topology and the delivered code.
  • Next November 2026 Per-paraphrase robustness, measured with a pilot that reads text.
  • Next November 2026 The KPI report on dynamic-scenario stress, per scenario family.
